create_instances_with_fields: create an Instances object with image size and fields like boxes, masks, and labels
index_instances_by_condition: index Instances to filter detections by confidence score or predicted class label
concatenate_instance_lists: concatenate multiple Instances objects from the same image into a single Instances object
move_instances_to_device: move all tensor fields in an Instances object to a specified GPU or CPU device
inspect_instances_fields: inspect and retrieve all field names and their data from an Instances object
